title: Portable Agent Memory Artifact
description: Top-level envelope for a Portable Agent Memory artifact. Contains agent provenance, cryptographic integrity fields, capability tokens, and the five memory components.

pam_version.description: Version of the Portable Agent Memory protocol this artifact conforms to.

schema_version.description: Version of the artifact envelope schema.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this artifact was created.

source_agent.description: Provenance metadata identifying the agent that produced this artifact.

name.description: Human-readable name of the source agent.

model_family.description: Model family the agent is based on.

runtime.description: Framework or runtime the agent executes within.

version.description: Version identifier for the agent or its runtime.

root_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash (hex-encoded) computed over the canonical serialization of the components object. Provides tamper-evident integrity.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (base64-encoded) over the root_hash, produced by the source agent's private key.

capability_tokens.description: Capability tokens granting scoped permissions over entries in this artifact.

components.description: The five Portable Agent Memory components.

episodic.description: Episodic memory — records of events, interactions, and observations.

semantic.description: Semantic memory — structured knowledge triples derived from experience.

procedural.description: Procedural memory — learned skills, procedures, and executable routines.

working.description: Working memory — active goals, reasoning scratchpad, and pending actions.

identity.description: Identity memory — persona, preferences, policies, and custom instructions.
